_comment: STDVEC-1 (GATES-SHIFTLEFT-BUILD-SPEC.md §2). Each vector = input + expected verdict + citation to the publishing authority. Positive AND negative per family — a validator that returns valid for everything must fail this suite.

iban.citation: ISO 13616 (IBAN structure) + ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 97-10 check-digit algorithm

vectors.note: canonical Wikipedia/ISO worked example, UK IBAN
one digit short of valid GB IBAN length

lei.citation: ISO 17442 (Legal Entity Identifier) — check digits computed per ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 97-10 over the full 20-character string

bic.citation: ISO 9362 (Business Identifier Code) structure: 4 bank-code letters + 2 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country letters + 2 alnum location + optional 3 alnum branch

vectors.note: Deutsche Bank AG, Frankfurt — published 8-char BIC
same institution, 11-char BIC with branch code
bank code must be letters only, leading digit invalid

uetr.citation: SWIFT gpi Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference = RFC 4122 UUID version 4

vectors.note: well-formed UUIDv4: version nibble 4, variant nibble in 8-b range
variant nibble 'c' is outside the required 8/9/a/b range

nacha_routing.citation: ABA/NACHA routing transit number — weighted checksum per the American Bankers Association RTN scheme (weights 3,7,1 repeating)

vectors.note: JPMorgan Chase Bank, NY — publicly published ABA routing number
final digit changed 1→9, checksum no longer divisible by 10
